title: observability-bundle-lock.v1
description: The set of product alert bundles accepted for one environment. A lock is an identity, not a version string: promotion fetches the artifact and refuses it unless every digest matches.

source_revision.description: Full 40-character SHA on the product's PROTECTED main, reasserted as current at promotion time. Not a tag, not a branch, not an abbreviation.

rules_artifact.description: Immutable pointer to the rules artifact — a registry reference or release-asset URL that cannot be rewritten in place.

metrics_manifest_sha256.description: The manifest declaring metric names, types, units and bounded label vocabularies. Rule 8's producer proof is checked against this: an alert over an undeclared metric is permanently silent and reads as 'all clear'.

rule_count.description: Exact number of rules the artifact must contain. Zero is never valid here — an empty bundle that loads cleanly is the failure this field exists to catch, and an unbacked rule is OMITTED from the bundle rather than shipped inert.
